sn48.169-178:1.1: cattāro’me bhikkhave, oghā …pe… bhāvetabbānīti. 4. 17. 120. uddhambhāgiyasuttaṃ pañcimāni bhikkhave, uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
sn48.169-178:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya pañcindriyāni bhāvetabbāni.
sn48.169-178:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ …pe… paññindriyaṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ.
sn48.169-178:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya imāni pañcindriyāni bhāvetabbānīti.
sn48.169-178:1.9: (ettha ca vuttanayena abhiññādi vasena ca vitthārentena vīsaṃsataṃ suttantā veditabbā.) punaoghavaggo sattarasamo.
sn48.169-178:2.5: indriyasaṃyuttaṃ samattaṃ. tatravagguddānaṃ: suddhakamudutara chaḷindriyā sukhindriyā jarāvaggehi pañca sūkarakhata sambodhayogaṅgāppamādabalakaraṇīyesanoghā punagaṅgāpeyyāla ādīhipi pañcahi vaggā sattarasa hontīti.
